test_item_verbatim: RVCF2.2) Display “Camera System Unavailable” message for any event which creates a blue screen condition

tcs.tc_title: Camera System Unavailable is displayed for an event that creates a blue screen
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The HU is in the Full-Operation state
2. PROXI Rear_View_Camera = 1 (Present)
3. The shift lever is in R
4. A blue screen condition has been created on the camera feed
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Read the HU display and check the screen colour
2. Read the HU display and check the message text
tcs.expected_result:
1. The display shows the blue screen
2. The display reads "Camera System Unavailable" (PU0169 of the R1 HMI pop-up list)
tcs.split_reason: Camera System Unavailable is displayed for an event that creates a blue screen
tcs.test_item:
RVCF2.2) Display “Camera System Unavailable” message for any event which creates a blue screen condition

(Camera System Unavailable is displayed for an event that creates a blue screen)

reasoning: §9.2.2 之條件為 `blue screen condition`。`PU0169` 之觸發欄逐字即 `Display “Camera System Unavailable” message for any event which creates a “blue screen” condition.` —— 與本條**逐字對應**（該欄另載 `[v.SR12]` 之版本註）。分工見 `-182`。
